meeting.title: ChowNow — SSO check-in
meeting.summary: Short check-in on ChowNow SSO. Marta confirmed the Okta SAML integration is configured and tested; no new work agreed.
key_decisions: SSO is confirmed working; go-live checklist item closes
meeting.notes: Quick call — pure status confirmation ahead of the go-live review next week.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: Thanks for squeezing this in — I just want to close the loop on SSO before the go-live review next week.

transcript.speaker: Marta Keller
transcript.text: Good news then. The Okta SAML integration is done — we configured it, tested it with five users yesterday, and everyone got in fine.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: Including the just-in-time provisioning for new users?

transcript.speaker: Marta Keller
transcript.text: Yes — two of the five testers had never logged in before and their accounts were created on first sign-in with the right group mappings.

transcript.speaker: Lukas Vogel
transcript.text: From my side that was the last item on the security checklist. I consider SSO closed.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: Excellent — I'll mark that task done on our board. Anything else you want to flag while we're on?

transcript.speaker: Lukas Vogel
transcript.text: Nothing concrete today. We might want to talk about SCIM deprovisioning someday, but it's not needed for go-live.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: Noted as a someday, not scheduling anything for it. Nice work Marta — see you both at the go-live review.

tasks.title: Validate restaurant dashboards against legacy numbers (parity sign-off)

expected.notes: Completion report: customer confirms Okta SAML SSO is configured and tested, so the existing SSO task moves to Done; the SCIM remark is a deliberate non-commitment.
